interventions.detail: Installed missing audioread (imported by piano_transcription_inference but not pulled in by modern librosa)
Pinned librosa==0.9.2 because load_audio uses librosa.core.audio.util and positional resample args removed in 0.10+
apt-installed ffmpeg (mp3 decoding backend) and wget (used for checkpoint auto-download)
Used Python 3.12 with CPU-only torch from the PyTorch CPU wheel index instead of Python 3.7/PyTorch 1.4
Pre-downloaded checkpoint from Zenodo to ~/piano_transcription_inference_data in setup.sh
